cafe: Here you are. Mind the hot cup.

Two, please. One is for my sister.
I will put them in separate boxes.

Sorry about that. Keep the water.
No, but the chair is wet.
I can use this other chair.

Yes, next to the blue one.
I am sorry. Was it a long wait?

travel: One ticket to York, please.
Single or return?
Return. I am coming back tonight.
The next train leaves at ten.
Does this bus go to the park?
No, you need the number eight.
Where does that one stop?
Across the road, by the bank.
I am early for my train.
There is one leaving now.
Can I use this ticket?
Not on that train. Yours leaves later.
I cannot find my bag.
What colour is it?
Red, with a small yellow star.
There is a red bag at the desk.
What time is our flight now?
It says half past four.
We have time for lunch, then.
Yes, but stay near the gate.
Is this bike free?
Yes. The key is in the basket.
Can I bring it back here?
Before six, please. We close then.
Are there steps at the station?
Only at the front door.
My dad uses a wheelchair.
Use the side door. It is flat.
Are we sharing this taxi?
Yes. I live near your street.
Let us ask the price first.
The driver says ten pounds each.
Our train is not coming.
There is another one at two.
I cannot wait that long.
The desk can help with a refund.
Shall we walk or take the bus?
How far is the museum?
About fifteen minutes on foot.
Let us walk. It is sunny.
hotel: Hello. The booking is under Green.
Two nights in a single room?
Yes. Is it on this floor?
The next floor up. Here is your key.
Where do we have breakfast?
In the room behind the stairs.
Can we go there at seven?
Yes. The doors open at half past six.
My room is near the road.
Is the noise keeping you awake?
Yes. Is there a room at the back?
Room twelve is free. I can show you.
Do we have to leave at ten?
Eleven is fine today.
Good. Our bus leaves at twelve.
You can wait in the lounge.
Have you got a phone charger?
What kind of phone is it?
The same as that one on your desk.
This charger should fit. Try it.
Where can I wash my shirt?
There is a laundry downstairs.
Do I need any coins?
No. You pay at the front desk.
Can we arrive on Friday instead?
Let me look at the booking.
We can still stay for two nights.
Friday is full, but Saturday is free.
My key is not in my bag.
Did you leave it in the room?
I think it is on the bed.
Show me your name and I can help.
There is a wrong name on my bill.
Which name should be there?
Anna Wood, with two letters O.
Thank you. I will print it again.
Did you enjoy your room?
The bed was good, but the shower was cold.
Oh dear. We will check it today.
Thank you. The room number is nine.
shopping: Do you have this shirt in blue?
There is a blue one on that shelf.
Can I try it on?

This jacket is too small.
Did you keep the receipt?
Yes, it is in the pocket.
We have a bigger size over here.
This says twelve pounds online.
The label here says fifteen.
Which price do I pay?
Twelve. That offer started this morning.

Have you tried another plug?
Yes. My other lamp works there.
Bring this one to the help desk.
I am here for a book.
What is the order number?
I cannot find the email.
Your name will help us find it.
Is this box for a present?
Yes, for my brother.
Would you like some red paper?
Blue, please. That is his favourite.
Can I pay with this gift card?
There are five pounds on it.
The socks cost six pounds.
You can pay the other pound in cash.
How old is this bike?
About three years old.
Can I try the brakes?
Certainly. There is space behind the shop.
I have my own bag.
Then you do not need a plastic one.
Could you leave the box here too?
Of course. We can use it again.
Is the new story book here yet?
It arrives on Monday.
Can you keep one for me?
Write your name on this list.
home: The kitchen needs cleaning.
I can wash the plates.
Thanks. I will clean the floor.
Where do you keep the small brush?
There is water under the sink.
Is the tap still running?
No, I turned it off.
I will get a towel and call Sam.
Could I borrow your ladder?
It is in the garden.
I need to change a light.
Please bring it back before Sunday.
A box came for you.
Did you put it by the door?
No, it is in the hall.
Ah, yes. That is my new coat.
Is that your music upstairs?
Yes. Is it too loud?
A little. My baby is asleep.
Sorry. I can use my headphones.
Is the spare room still free?
Yes. Would you like to see it?
Does it have a desk?
A small one, next to the window.
Are these boxes ready to go?
Only the ones with red tape.
What is in this big one?
Books. Be careful, it is heavy.
Why are all the lights on?
I forgot the one in the kitchen.
I will turn it off.
Thanks. The bill was high last month.
Can we stay here next year?
I would like that too.
Shall we ask about the rent?
Yes, before we sign anything.
Who is feeding your cat tomorrow?
My neighbour, but she needs a key.
I can give her our spare one.
Please tell her the food is in the kitchen.
health: I would like to see someone.
Is Tuesday morning all right?
I work on Tuesday. How about Friday?
There is a free time at nine.
Is this the easy exercise class?
Yes. Is it your first time?
It is. Where do I stand?
Near me, so you can see my feet.
You look tired this morning.
I went to bed very late.
Was there something on television?
No, I was finishing some work.
Is there any milk in this soup?
I am not sure. Let me ask.
Please do. I need to know.
The cook has a list of everything in it.
Are you coming on the walk?
How long does it take?
About an hour, with a short break.
Then I will bring some water.
Where can I fill my bottle?
There is a tap by the gate.
That one is not working.
Try the one inside the sports hall.
Can we stop for five minutes?
Yes. We have been sitting here for hours.
I am going outside for some air.
I will open the window while you are gone.
The dance teacher is away today.
Is the class off, then?
There is another teacher at six.
That is too late for me this week.
What is in your little notebook?

Did you walk today?
Yes, but only as far as the shops.
The changing room door is stuck.
Is anyone inside?
No. I left my coat in there.
I will ask the person at the desk.

I want to learn to draw.

Yes. You do not need to bring anything.
Can you listen to my short talk?

Tell me if I speak too quietly.
I cannot hear you yet. Try again.
I cannot see the lesson link.

Oh, I opened the second one.
There it is. Click the blue words.
Who wrote this book?

I can only see the title.
Turn it over. The writer is on the back.
There is a test on Thursday.

No, look at the class calendar.
